analysis_kind: descriptive audit of committed measurements; no new timing or policy replay

definitions.reference: minimum bank-1 latency, ties by config key; that config scored on bank 2
definitions.ratio: bank-2 reference latency / bank-2 torch latency; above 1 favors torch
definitions.wins: strict comparison of stored median latencies, not a significance test
definitions.aggregation: geometric mean of workload ratios within each displayed group
definitions.equal_fold_mean: arithmetic mean of per-model geometric means, matching the published torch curve
definitions.shape_duplicates: distinct model/projection workloads kept; shape groups geometrically average them, not independent devices
definitions.best_bank2: minimum of all curated config latencies on scoring bank 2; optimistic in-sample diagnostic, not an independently selected deployable policy
definitions.spread: count of torch p80 < reference p20; within-run central spreads, not confidence intervals or paired tests

limits: One fixed corpus and collected GPU instances; no new-device uncertainty estimate.
Torch timings are duplicated across config rows and counted once per workload/bank.
The curated reference is not a hardware ceiling; no causal hardware bottleneck is identified.
Bank-2 best-config selection is optimistic and cannot be used as a held-out policy score.
Kernel profiling, matched stricter accumulation and deployment cost are not measured by this audit.

collection.contract: Allocating FP16 timed callables; separate FP32-input correctness reference with TF32 disabled, converted to FP16. Torch median only. Same nominal timing/numerical settings, different acquisition stages; runtime accumulation/device-state uncertainty remains.

collection.timing_settings_provenance: collector defaults (25/100 ms), not confirmed T4 invocation arguments; the post-run manifest does not record T4 timing overrides
collection.contract: Allocating FP16 timed callables; separate FP32-input correctness reference with TF32 disabled, converted to FP16. Torch median only. Same nominal timing/numerical settings, different acquisition stages; runtime accumulation/device-state uncertainty remains.

overview_note: Separate within-GPU summaries, not a pooled four-GPU estimate or policy replay. L4/A10 are earlier acquisition; T4 is validation acquisition; H100 is final acquisition. All use the same workload/config rosters, bank-1 selection and bank-2 scoring.

timing_contract.inputs_output: row-major CUDA FP16 A[M,K], B[K,N], FP16 output; Triton FP32 accumulator
timing_contract.correctness: Triton checked against FP32-input torch.matmul with TF32 disabled, converted to FP16, atol=rtol=0.01; distinct from the timed FP16 torch comparator
timing_contract.timing: triton.testing.do_bench warmed allocating callables; Triton p20/median/p80, torch median only; not CUDA-graph or end-to-end serving latency
timing_contract.excluded: compilation, policy compute, physical source acquisition, amortization and production interference
timing_contract.torch_precision: historical torch backend accumulation settings are not fully recorded in the timing rows; no assertion of matched stricter precision

published_policy_context.note: budget curves average fold geometric means over seeds; torch is evaluation-only, outside the action set; AUC is mean of eight budgets
